text: Wasserman’s shows why concern about a formula does not always justify deciding its validity on summary judgment. The lease’s economic value and the nature of the loss matter alongside sales figures.
sourceSummary: A lease-cancellation payment based on gross receipts required factual examination of its reasonableness; the court preserved reimbursement for improvements but did not finally uphold or invalidate the receipts formula.
basis: Synthesis of the cited assigned excerpt.
